name: SikaPlast®-70
summary: SikaPlast®-70 is a water reducer specifically formulated for use with harsh manufactured sands or poorly-graded natural sand. SikaPlast®-70 improves the finishability, pumping and slump keeping properties of the fresh concrete.
metaDescription: SikaPlast®-70 is a water reducer specifically formulated for use with harsh manufactured sands or poorly-graded natural sand. SikaPlast®-70 improves the finishability, pumping and slump keeping properties of the fresh concrete.
attributes: Facilitates an increase in manufactured sand or poor quality natural sand.
usage:
SikaPlast®-70 is suitable to produce high performance concrete with poor quality sands. 
  The following types of concrete can use SikaPlast®-70:
Mixes containing harsh aggregates and high percentage of manufactured sand
Reinforced, precast, prestressed, lightweight, normal weight or pumped concrete.
Concrete, where reduced water contents and ease of placing and working with tools is needed.
advantages: Use of SikaPlast®-70 in concrete improves the following properties:
Facilitates an increase in manufactured sand or poor quality natural sand.
packaging: Bulk deliveries 205 litre drum 10 litre container

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: SikaPlast®-70 is a medium-range water reducing admixture meeting the requirements of AS1478.1 – 2000 Type MWR.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers, protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is at least one (1) year.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store at temperature between 5oC and 35oC, protected from direct sunlight .

items.label: Dispensing
items.text:
Add SikaPlast®-70 to the initial batching water. For best result, we recommend thorough mixing of wet concrete at 60 seconds per cubic metre of concrete.
Add the remaining gauging water progressively after at least 2/3 wet mixing time to achieve the desired consistency.
Do not add to a dry mix.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
SikaPlast®-70 can be use in conjunction with most of the Sika Concrete admixture, with the exclusion of Sikament NN.
For additional information, please contact your local Sika Representative.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text: Typical dosage for general concrete production is between 300-600mls per 100kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage depends on site condition, job conditions, mix ingredients and desired plastic and hardened properties. Laboratory and field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage. SikaPlast®-70 can be used at higher doses to achieve a large water cut and increased set times.
